The test image shows a tomato leaf with a distinctive **white powdery coating** spread across the upper leaf surface in expanding patches. The leaf is otherwise intact (no necrotic lesions, no spots with rings, no yellowing curling). This matches Powdery Mildew perfectly — the reference images confirm the same grayish-white powdery sporulation spread across the leaf surface in round spots that converge.

Key distinguishing features:
- Dense white/grayish powdery growth on leaf surface
- No concentric rings (rules out Early Blight, Target Spot)
- No water-soaked lesions (rules out Bacterial Spot, Late Blight)
- No yellowing/curling (rules out TYLCV)
- No webbing (rules out Spider Mites)
